create.name: Marla Apt
create.bio:
Marla Apt is a senior certified Iyengar Yoga teacher based in Los Angeles. She began studying with B.K.S. Iyengar and his children Geeta and Prashant in India some thirty years ago, and has taught for more than a quarter of a century. Yoga Journal once picked her as one of twenty-one teachers likely to shape yoga's future. She has led the US national Iyengar association (IYNAUS) as its president, helped write its ethical guidelines and teaching standards, and sits on the board of Iyengar Yoga Therapeutics, a non-profit she helped form.

She runs live online asana classes three times a week at beginner, intermediate and mixed levels, keeps a library of recorded classes to rent, and leads study sessions for teachers working towards Iyengar certification. When in Los Angeles she teaches weekly classes at the Culver City Iyengar institute, and she travels to lead weekend workshops in the United States and Japan and residential retreats, including a summer week at Feathered Pipe Ranch in Montana.

courses.title: Live online Iyengar Yoga classes
courses.description: Weekly live asana classes on Zoom: beginners on Tuesdays, intermediate on Thursdays and all levels on Sundays (Pacific time), booked through her class membership.
courses.price: Drop in: $18; 5 class pass: $81; Unlimited asana: $108/month

courses.title: Recorded class library
courses.description: Recordings of all her weekly online classes, for students who cannot attend live. Rent a single class or subscribe to the full library.
courses.price: Single class, 72-hour rental: $15; All videos, monthly unlimited: $108

courses.title: Online Yoga Teacher Study Sessions
courses.description: Sunday study groups for Iyengar teachers in training (Level 1) and certified teachers (Levels 2 and 3), focused on teaching skills and the syllabus. Recordings go to all who register.
courses.price: $75 for all 3 sessions. $30 for individual sessions

courses.title: Iyengar Yoga Retreat at Feathered Pipe Ranch, Montana (2027)
courses.description: Her week-long residential Iyengar intensive at Feathered Pipe Ranch near Helena, Montana.
